experiment: P5b frozen heterogeneous route nine-power and weak-component boundary
research_question: Does the frozen full-width MLCNN-classification plus IQ-Grouped-parameter route retain its parameter benefit across paired 10-50 dB power views without damaging classification, and where do target-specific physical-sufficiency boundaries appear?

weak_component_contract.power_below_30_db: MFT, VFT and ISRJ positives are weak components when any FMB, SawFM or SinFM component is present
weak_component_contract.power_above_30_db: FMB, SawFM and SinFM positives are weak components when any MFT, VFT or ISRJ component is present

trigger_if: a target violates the three-seed systematic NMAE gate at any power
weak-component target error rises monotonically as its relative power falls
classification recall and predicted-gate coverage collapse together
physical_sufficiency_trigger.next_test: frozen-feature or analytic oracle on the failed target and powers using a new role or new identities
physical_sufficiency_trigger.capacity_rule: if the oracle fails, no deeper learned expert may be constructed

stop_rules: Do not train, recalibrate or select thresholds on P5b data.
Do not treat the nine power views as independent samples in statistics.
If classification recall increases while AUPR, hard-negative separation or FPR worsens, record response amplification and do not promote.
If any identity overlap or power-pairing validity check fails, invalidate evaluation before model inference.
Failure defines a generalization boundary and routes to physical-sufficiency screening; it does not authorize model deepening.
